name: Crownhate Ruin
label: Dischord
lede: Fred Erskine and Joe McRedmond finished with Hoover in 1994 and were on stage as Crownhate Ruin barely two months later, with drummer Vin Novara and a darker set of songs. Some Hoover fans weren't thrilled. The band kept touring, made one album for Dischord, and was done by December 1996.

eras.title: Hoover ends, the next band starts
eras.text: Hoover lasted about two years and one Dischord album, The Lurid Traversal of Route 7. Erskine and McRedmond didn't wait around: Dischord dates Crownhate Ruin to May 1994.

years.h: [[Hoover|d691df14-6955-4cae-9dcc-318fb7d75984]] ends, and two of its three singers keep going
years.p: Hoover, the D.C. band where three of four members shared vocals, splits in 1994, the year The Lurid Traversal of Route 7 comes out. [[Fred Erskine|4e2f1c33-e9a9-4aff-9b90-d9b1d3e8af19]] and [[Joe McRedmond|132df41f-6981-4db5-93cc-47aa88b825c9]] stay together.

years.h: First show, barely two months after Hoover
years.p: [[Fred Erskine|4e2f1c33-e9a9-4aff-9b90-d9b1d3e8af19]] plays bass and sings, [[Joe McRedmond|132df41f-6981-4db5-93cc-47aa88b825c9]] plays guitar and sings, and [[Vin Novara|bfec86c6-f1ae-4915-ac83-c1806a929118]], ex-[[1.6 Band|e3b548df-c063-4603-bac1-1b01fcf84ef2]], takes the drums.
years.xp:
Dischord says the music moved into "a darker area, with more challenging arrangements and time-signatures" than Hoover's. AllMusic describes slashing guitars and screamed vocals.

Erskine was a trained musician: violin from age four, then piano, then trumpet at eight, per Wikipedia. He picked up bass only after joining a punk band as a singer in 1987.

years.h: Hoover fans meet the new band with mixed feelings
years.p: Dischord says the reception from some Hoover followers was mixed at first. The band built its own following through touring.
years.xp: Dischord's own line is that Crownhate Ruin "began to develop its own following through touring." The WFMU session from November 1994 shows where the band stood six months in.

eras.title: Seven-inches and a Southern run
eras.text: Wikipedia says the band started touring and recording right away. 1995 brought three singles and a split with Boston's Karate.

years.h: Three seven-inches in one year, six songs
years.p: "Lesson in Thread" backed with "Pioneers"; "Present to President" and "Last Place in Triage" backed with "My Country Getaway"; then "Better Still If They Don't Know" with "Every Minute's Sucker."

yt: Ford Court House, Auburn AL, July 10, 1995
years.h: Crownhate Ruin shares a seven-inch with [[Karate|7d942b74-f556-49c5-8987-067dc0488c90]]
years.p: The split with Boston's Karate comes out on Art Monk Construction, the small D.C. label named for Redskins receiver Art Monk.

years.h: Live at the Ford Court House, Auburn AL, July 10, 1995
yt: Live at the Ford Court House, Auburn AL, July 10, 1995

eras.title: One album, then Chicago
eras.text: The band made its only full-length in 1996 with Geoff Turner at WGNS. By December it was over and Erskine was headed for Chicago.

years.p: Dischord lists it as an early-1996 release, on a half-number in the catalog, ahead of the album Until the Eagle Grins.

years.h: Until the Eagle Grins, recorded at WGNS
years.p: Crownhate Ruin's only album, produced by [[Geoff Turner|591fc466-2668-4524-852d-a6cc5f18cff7]]: ten songs, including "Late Arriving Rock Dudes" and "Tornado Season Finale," plus both sides of the "Better Still If They Don't Know" single.

years.h: By December, Erskine is on his way to Chicago
years.p: Dischord closes Crownhate Ruin's run in December 1996. Erskine joins [[June of 44|56f3de75-2c88-4054-a1df-65c661f4ee0f]], per AllMusic.

eras.title: Same three players, other bands
eras.text: Erskine, McRedmond and Novara kept turning up in each other's bands. Hoover came back in 1997 and 2004, and in 2022 the early singles were finally collected.

years.p: In 1997 Hoover records a mini-album of odds and ends for Slowdime, and returns in 2004 for US and European dates. Later the players work together in Boom, HiM and [[The Sorts|fc0377f7-b7fc-4b17-9cef-3db0fa5c6d00]], per Wikipedia.

years.h: 20 Years of Dischord includes Crownhate Ruin
years.p: The band makes Dischord's anniversary set, Dischord No. 125.

years.h: BCore Disc and New Atlantis collect the singles
years.p: Singles and Early Recordings: 1994–1995 has ten tracks, including the singles and early songs like "Visit from Mars." The digital edition is dated December 20, 2022.
